hebrewText: וְ/רָאִ֧יתִי לַ/בַּ֛יִת גֹּ֖בַהּ סָבִ֣יב סָבִ֑יב מיסדות מוּסְד֤וֹת הַ/צְּלָעוֹת֙ מְל֣וֹ הַ/קָּנֶ֔ה שֵׁ֥שׁ אַמּ֖וֹת אַצִּֽילָה

tokens.bdb: to see, literally or figuratively (in numerous applications, direct and implied, transitive, intransitive and causative)
tokens.kjv: advise self, appear, approve, behold, [idiom] certainly, consider, discern, (make to) enjoy, have experience, gaze, take heed, [idiom] indeed, [idiom] joyfully, lo, look (on, one another, one on another, one upon another, out, up, upon), mark, meet, [idiom] be near, perceive, present, provide, regard, (have) respect, (fore-, cause to, let) see(-r, -m, one another), shew (self), [idiom] sight of others, (e-) spy, stare, [idiom] surely, [idiom] think, view, visions.

tokens.bdb: a house (in the greatest variation of applications, especially family, etc.)
tokens.kjv: court, daughter, door, [phrase] dungeon, family, [phrase] forth of, [idiom] great as would contain, hangings, home(born), (winter) house(-hold), inside(-ward), palace, place, [phrase] prison, [phrase] steward, [phrase] tablet, temple, web, [phrase] within(-out).
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a house (in the greatest variation of applications
tokens.enLiteralWord: a house (in the greatest variation of applications
tokens.explanation: a house (in the greatest variation of applications
tokens.explanationEn: a house (in the greatest variation of applications

tokens.kjv: excellency, haughty, height, high, loftiness, pride.

tokens.bdb: (as noun) a circle, neighbour, or environs; but chiefly (as adverb, with or without preposition) around
tokens.kjv: (place, round) about, circuit, compass, on every side.

tokens.bdb: (as noun) a circle, neighbour, or environs; but chiefly (as adverb, with or without preposition) around
tokens.kjv: (place, round) about, circuit, compass, on every side.

tokens.bdb: a rib (as curved), literally (of the body) or figuratively (of a door, i.e. leaf); hence, a side, literally (of a person) or figuratively (of an object or the sky, i.e. quarter); architecturally, a (especially floor or ceiling) timber or plank (single or collective, i.e. a flooring)
tokens.kjv: beam, board, chamber, corner, leaf, plank, rib, side (chamber).
[idiom] all along, [idiom] all that is (there-) in, fill, ([idiom] that whereof...was) full, fulness, (hand-) full, multitude.

tokens.bdb: a reed (as erect); by resemblance a rod (especially for measuring), shaft, tube, stem, the radius (of the arm), beam (of a steelyard)
tokens.kjv: balance, bone, branch, calamus, cane, reed, [idiom] spearman, stalk.
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a reed ; by resemblance a rod
tokens.enLiteralWord: a reed ; by resemblance a rod
tokens.explanation: a reed ; by resemblance a rod
tokens.explanationEn: a reed ; by resemblance a rod

tokens.bdb: six (as an overplus  beyond five or the fingers of the hand); as ord. sixth
properly, a mother (i.e. unit of measure, or the fore-arm (below the elbow), i.e. a cubit; also a door-base (as a bond of the entrance)
tokens.kjv: cubit, [phrase] hundred (by exchange for H3967 (מֵאָה)), measure, post.

tokens.bdb: a joint of the hand (i.e. knuckle); also (according to some) a party-wall (Ezekiel 41:8)
tokens.ptLiteralWord: a joint of the hand ; also  a party-wall
tokens.enLiteralWord: a joint of the hand ; also  a party-wall
tokens.explanation: a joint of the hand ; also  a party-wall
